candidate_evidence.quote: non-randomized study of sintilimab (one anti-PD-1 antibody same as nivolumab approved in China) plus bevacizumab administered in a low dosage schedule

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: in adult (≥ 18 years) participants with a clinical relapse or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)-level relapse of glioblastoma (GBM).

role_evidence.quote: Sintilimab (One Anti-PD-1 Antibody) Plus Low-dose Bevacizumab for ctDNA-level-relapse and Clinical-relapse Glioblastoma

flag.reason: Registered intervention name says tislelizumab but description, title and brand (TYVYT) say sintilimab; coded sintilimab. Only investigational agent; bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy.

role_evidence.quote: plus bevacizumab administered in a low dosage schedule

flag.reason: Established GBM therapy given at a low-dose schedule as partner; could alternatively be soc_backbone.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour in situ fluid (TISF) ctDNA relapse status

source_quote.quote: The researcher will study the TISF ctDNA and imaging dynamics to determine whether the tumor reaches to ctDNA-level (Cohort 1) or clinical relapse (Cohort 2).

flag.reason: ctDNA dynamics used to assign cohort (relapse stage), not a target linked to the candidate; enrichment vs stratification debatable.

source_quote.quote: To evaluate the correlative biomarkers based on TISF ctDNA.

coder_notes: Two non-comparative cohorts defined by ctDNA-level vs clinical relapse. Inconsistent drug naming (tislelizumab vs sintilimab); AE outcome mentions durvalumab, apparently a copy error. Brief summary claim that sintilimab is 'same as nivolumab' is not used.
